title: A day of my mother
simplified_paragraphs: 妈妈在图书馆工作。她每天早上六点起床，起床后给我和爸爸做早饭，然后我们一起吃。七点半，她会先送我去学校，然后再去工作。图书馆九点开门，她常常差一刻九点到图书馆门口。中午妈妈会在图书馆的食堂吃饭。晚上我们一起在家吃晚饭，有时候一起看电视。这是我妈妈的一天。
traditional_paragraphs: 媽媽在圖書館工作。她每天早上六點起床，起床後給我和爸爸做早飯，然後我們一起吃。七點半，她會先送我去學校，然後再去工作。圖書館九點開門，她常常差一刻九點到圖書館門口。中午媽媽會在圖書館的食堂吃飯。晚上我們一起在家吃晚飯，有時候一起看電視。這是我媽媽的一天。
pinyin_paragraphs: mā ma zài tú shū guǎn gōng zuò。 tā měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn qǐ chuáng， qǐ chuáng hòu gěi wǒ hé bà ba zuò zǎo fàn， rán hòu wǒ men yī qǐ chī。 qī diǎn bàn， tā huì xiān sòng wǒ qù xué xiào， rán hòu zài qù gōng zuò。 tú shū guǎn jiǔ diǎn kāi mén， tā cháng cháng chà yī kè jiǔ diǎn dào tú shū guǎn mén kǒu。 zhōng wǔ mā ma huì zài tú shū guǎn de shí táng chī fàn。 wǎn shang wǒ men yī qǐ zài jiā chī wǎn fàn， yǒu shí hou yī qǐ kàn diàn shì。 zhè shì wǒ mā ma de yī tiān。
english_paragraphs: Mom works in the library. She gets up at six o'clock every morning, makes breakfast for me and my father, and then we eat together. At half past seven, she would send me to school first and then go to work. The library opened at nine o'clock, and she often arrived at the library door a quarter before nine o'clock. At noon, my mother will eat in the library cafeteria. In the evening we have dinner together at home and sometimes watch TV together. This is my mom's day.
english_full: Mom works in the library. She gets up at six o'clock every morning, makes breakfast for me and my father, and then we eat together. At half past seven, she would send me to school first and then go to work. The library opened at nine o'clock, and she often arrived at the library door a quarter before nine o'clock. At noon, my mother will eat in the library cafeteria. In the evening we have dinner together at home and sometimes watch TV together. This is my mom's day.
